nodeGroups.name: Check order request
nodeGroups.description: Rejects missing fields, empty or invalid items, bad quantities and orders the customer has not explicitly confirmed

nodeGroups.name: Verify and price order
nodeGroups.description: Checks customer, restaurant, menu items and delivery area against the sheets, then totals using sheet prices and fees only

nodeGroups.name: Save order items
nodeGroups.description: Writes one line per ordered item under the new order and reports a partial failure if any line is not confirmed
